articles.title: Tie at the Top: Sierra and Mt. SAC Split the Title in a Thrilling Finish
articles.summary: In a first for California community college swimming, Sierra and Mt. San Antonio tied for the men's title with 421 points each. American River was just three points back.

articles.title: Australia's Film Industry Boom: How a Tax Break Lured Hollywood Down Under
articles.summary: After Australia boosted its Location Offset to 30%, film spending hit a record $1.93 billion. Studios like Netflix and Amazon are returning for multiple projects.

articles.title: Inside the Indie Film Market: UTA's Rena Ronson on Disruption, AI, and Her Cannes Ritual
articles.summary: Veteran sales agent Rena Ronson discusses decades of change in indie film, how AI could lower budgets for new voices, and her sacred Cannes tradition.
